objects.description: [InvisibleFerret](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1245) has terminated Chrome and Brave browsers using the `taskkill` command on Windows and the `killall` command on other systems such as Linux and macOS.(Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025) [InvisibleFerret](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1245) has also utilized it’s `ssh_kill` command to terminate Chrome and Brave browser processes.(Citation: PaloAlto ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2023)
objects.description_fa: [InvisibleFerret](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S1245) مرورگرهای Chrome و Brave را با استفاده از دستور «taskkill» در Windows و فرمان «killall» در سیستم‌های دیگر مانند Linux و macOS پایان داده است. فرمان «ssh_kill» برای پایان دادن به فرآیندهای مرورگر Chrome و Brave.(Citation: PaloAlto ContagiousInterview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret November 2023) (Citation: ESET Contagious Interview BeaverTail InvisibleFerret February 2025)
